title: KernelSight-LM: A Kernel-Level LLM Inference Simulator
authors: Xiteng Yao; Taeho Kim; Hengzhi Pei; Xinle Liu; Kyle Ulrich; Leonard Lausen; Ashish Khetan; Xiang Song; George Karypis; Martin Herbordt
research_focus: LLM serving, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Capacity planning, Continuous batching, Long-context / Prefix cache, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: End-to-end LLM inference behavior couples serving-layer policies (batching, scheduling, prefix caching) with low-level GPU kernel execution on rapidly evolving architectures, forcing slow, deployment-specific benchmarking; prior tools either measure on the target GPU (cannot extrapolate) or forecast across GPUs (blind to serving dynamics).
problem_statement.zh: LLM inference 的端到端行為將 serving 層策略（batching、scheduling、prefix caching）與底層 GPU kernel 執行及快速演進的硬體架構耦合在一起，迫使業界進行緩慢且綁定特定部署的 benchmarking；既有工具要麼依賴目標 GPU 上的量測（無法外推），要麼跨 GPU 預測（無法反映 serving 動態）。

key_innovation.en: A kernel-level latency predictor (roofline with wave quantization x learned per-family efficiency heads + NCCL all-reduce communication model + measured host-overhead model) composed through a Vidur-based discrete-event simulator that re-implements vLLM v1's scheduler with continuous batching, chunked prefill, and two-tier prefix caching; two prediction tiers trade target-GPU data for accuracy (Tier A: datasheet-only zero-shot cross-generation; Tier B: one model-agnostic microbenchmark sweep on the target).
key_innovation.zh: kernel 級延遲預測器（roofline 結合 wave quantization x 各 kernel family 的學習式效率頭 + NCCL all-reduce 通訊模型 + 量測式 host 開銷模型），並透過基於 Vidur 的 discrete-event 模擬器組合：逐步重現 vLLM v1 scheduler 的 continuous batching、chunked prefill 與兩層 prefix caching；提供兩個預測層級以目標 GPU 資料換取精度（Tier A：僅憑 datasheet 的 zero-shot 跨世代預測；Tier B：在目標 GPU 上跑一次與模型無關的 microbenchmark sweep）。

key_improvements.en: Predicts per-kernel latency on an unseen GPU generation (GB200) to 12.1% error, 1.8x better than the roofline baseline NeuSight (22.0%); target-measured tier reaches 3.8% per-kernel error, 7.3x over AIConfigurator (27.7%); end-to-end p50 errors across six model families of 15.4%/12.8%/3.0% (TTFT/TPOT/throughput) cross-generation and 14.3%/6.2%/2.7% target-measured.
key_improvements.zh: 在未見過的 GPU 世代（GB200）上預測 per-kernel latency 誤差為 12.1%，較 roofline baseline NeuSight（22.0%）改善 1.8x；target-measured 層級將 per-kernel 誤差降至 3.8%，較 AIConfigurator（27.7%）改善 7.3x；六個模型家族的端到端 p50 誤差在跨世代層級為 15.4%/12.8%/3.0%（TTFT/TPOT/throughput），target-measured 層級為 14.3%/6.2%/2.7%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA A10G, NVIDIA A40, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H200, NVIDIA L4, NVIDIA L40S, NVIDIA GB200, NVIDIA GB10, NVIDIA RTX 5090
gpu_count: 8x per AWS instance (A100/A10G/H100/H200/L4), 4x GB200; TP up to 4
reported_accuracy: Per-kernel MAPE 12.1% (Tier A) / 3.8% (Tier B); E2E p50 TTFT/TPOT/throughput 15.4%/12.8%/3.0% (A), 14.3%/6.2%/2.7% (B)
models_validated: Llama-3.2-1B/3B, Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen3-4B/8B/14B/32B, DeepSeek-LLM-7B/67B, DeepSeek-Coder-33B, Phi-2, Phi-4-mini, Phi-4, Gemma-2-9B, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3
validation_workloads: Production trace (conversation, up to 500 requests per configuration), Kernel microbenchmarks (CUDA-graph)

scope_assumptions.en: Cross-generation transfer of the learned efficiency factor is weakest for attention kernels (efficiency 3-3.5x off roofline with up to 3.8x cross-device spread), motivating one-shot per-architecture attention calibration; TTFT error grows from 15% to 74% past saturation (rho ~1.2) because the host model excludes the saturated regime; validated on dense decoder-only models with vLLM v0.19.0, TP up to 4; GB200 held out as cross-generation target; edge GPUs (RTX 5090, GB10) excluded from the training ladder.
scope_assumptions.zh: 學習式效率因子的跨世代轉移在 attention kernel 上最弱（效率偏離 roofline 3-3.5x，跨裝置差異最高 3.8x），因此需要對每個新架構做一次 attention 校準；超過飽和點（rho 約 1.2）後 TTFT 誤差由 15% 升至 74%，因為 host 模型未涵蓋飽和情境；驗證僅涵蓋 dense decoder-only 模型，使用 vLLM v0.19.0、TP 最多 4；GB200 作為跨世代測試時完全保留，邊緣 GPU（RTX 5090、GB10）不納入訓練階梯。
